reader_note: The value states the Board's composition from several sides: 11 current directors reduced to seven nominees at the meeting, the 8-of-11 independence determination, the three standing committees with members and chairs (membership chart, nominee cards, Audit and Compensation report signatures, CD&A), Redstone as Non-Executive Chair, the audit committee financial experts, the May 2023 departures of Beinecke and Nelson and the Compensation Committee interlocks statement. Nearly every pool fact repeats one of these (highlights nominee table with its legend, the leadership list 'non-executive Chair, CEO, nine others, eight independent', agenda items for seven directors); the one pool fact not in the value is that the independent Nominating and Governance Chair presides at independent-director sessions (421). Judgment calls: plain 'Director' role lines on the nominee cards were read as FACT (board-role field of a card), the nominee table's legend was counted but its generic column headers and the chart caption were not, and bio tenure sentences were read as tenure.
